situation: A regional road freight operator with roughly 180 staff and 60 vehicles. The board has asked the operations director to bring back a shortlist of AI initiatives before the November review. Nobody in the company has run an AI project before.

objectives.statement: Reduce late deliveries on the regional network
objectives.rationale: Two large retail customers have raised it in the last quarterly review and one has hinted at retendering.

objectives.statement: Lower the administrative cost per shipment

constraints.value: about 150,000 EUR for the first year, including internal time
constraints.notes: The operations director believes this is approved but has not seen it confirmed in writing.
A constraint the manager knows exists but has not quantified.

constraints.value: something demonstrable before the board review in November
customer address data cannot leave the EU

initiatives.name: Route optimisation assistant
initiatives.description: Suggest daily route adjustments to dispatchers based on traffic, load and delivery windows.

initiatives.name: Customs document extraction
initiatives.description: Extract structured fields from scanned customs paperwork so that clerks check rather than retype.
